name: realtimex-mailkeeper
description: Keeps your inbox clean on a schedule: rules you promote, everything else proposed, every run reversible. Any IMAP provider via the Himalaya account configured in BizOps.

api_routes.description: Read a workspace MailKeeper profile, readiness state, promoted rules, and last run summary.
Record a finite cleanup run receipt (actions taken, proposals, urgent items), including after workspace deactivation.
Promote a proposed rule so the heartbeat may execute it unattended. Human-only.
Demote a promoted rule back to proposal. Human-only.
Reverse every action recorded in one run receipt by UID.
Explicitly re-provision the profile-owned thread, contract file, and managed heartbeat task.

configSchema.label: Mode ceiling
configSchema.description: Highest mode any workspace may use. Set once, globally.

options.label: Label only (move to Auto/* folders, never leave the inbox)

configSchema.label: Auto folder prefix
configSchema.description: Folder prefix for audit-trail moves, e.g. Auto/Newsletters.

configSchema.label: Protected sender domains
configSchema.description: Sender domains no rule may ever touch. Applies to every workspace.

configSchema.label: Run receipt retention (days)
configSchema.description: How long run receipts (and undo) are kept.

configSchema.label: Email account
configSchema.description: Himalaya account name (the [accounts.<name>] key in the BizOps email config). Not an address.

configSchema.label: Mode
configSchema.description: What the heartbeat may do unattended. Cannot exceed the global mode ceiling.

configSchema.label: Heartbeat cadence
configSchema.description: How often the maintenance run happens. Follows this workspace's heartbeat active hours and pause state.

configSchema.label: Age threshold (days)
configSchema.description: Messages older than this qualify for the age pass.

configSchema.label: Aggressiveness
configSchema.description: Which passes may be promoted. See MAILBOX.md for the pass list per level.

configSchema.label: VIP senders
configSchema.description: Addresses or domains that are never touched. Seeds MAILBOX.md.

configSchema.label: Maintenance agent
configSchema.description: Terminal agent that runs the maintenance task.

configSchema.label: Model
configSchema.description: Optional. Empty means the agent's default model.
